CG-CLOSED-TYPE.rule: Event types are drawn from the closed Cancer Genetics task-specific set.

CG-TRIGGER.rule: Every event has a contiguous source trigger with exact character offsets and the trigger type must equal the event type.

CG-ROLES.rule: Theme undergoes the event's primary effect, Cause is causally active, and Participant is involved without a more specific local role.

CG-NESTING.rule: An event participant may target another event, preserving the typed nested event structure.

CG-MODIFIER.rule: Negation and speculation modify a specific event and are part of the complete event instance.

CG-GOLD-INSTANCE.rule: Benchmark credit requires the complete public gold event instance: trigger, event type, typed arguments, nested references, and modifiers.

SOURCE-COMPLETE.rule: Source-only acceptance requires the complete proposed typed event, not merely a generally plausible statement in the passage.
